thread:
lee-recruiter: Quick Q  Sam (new hire) is UK-based on a Skilled Worker visa. His BRP was stolen last week and he has a police report + online BRP replacement receipt. Start date June 7. Can he onboard remotely from the UK while BRP replacement is in process?

marta-peopleops: Short answer: yes for unpaid onboarding and non-work activities; if he will perform work for Redwood while in UK we need to consider UK employment/tax and either use EOR or classify as contractor for the bridging period.

anya-legal: Agreed. Also note BRP replacement timeline: usually 24 weeks but can be longer. For UK-based work, local employment law applies immediately if he's performing duties. If he remains on his UK Skilled Worker sponsorship, employer-of-record rules may require sponsorship transfer if he were to join a UK payroll. So EOR is simplest for short bridging.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: EOR request form + budget tag. Link: https://internal.redwood/hr/eor-policy

lee-recruiter: Candidate prefers to onboard remotely and keep Redwood US offer intact. He wants payroll as Redwood W-2 once he arrives in US (he plans to relocate later).

marta-peopleops: We can't onboard as US W-2 while he's physically in UK. Options: 1) EOR for 2-6 weeks; 2) unpaid/voluntary onboarding (orientation, training) only; 3) contractor SOW via an approved vendor.

tom-payroll: If EOR, estimate ~£900£1,400 for a month depending on vendor. Benefits won't apply until W-2 conversion. We'll need a signed candidate consent and bank details for EOR.

lee-recruiter: Sam can do unpaid orientation for 2 weeks and then EOR for last 2 weeks before travel. He asked whether his BRP replacement receipt is sufficient for EOR docs.

anya-legal: EOR vendor usually accepts passport and police report plus BRP replacement receipt for identity verification, but vendor may require biometric appointment proof later. We'll flag this with Velocity and see if they can onboard pending final BRP.

marta-peopleops: Pre-approving up to $1,200 for EOR bridging for this role. If vendor estimate above that, escalate to finance. Please tag hiring cost center.

sam-newhire: I can do unpaid orientation week 1 and EOR week 2. I'll upload police report and BRP receipt now. Thank you.

lee-recruiter: Uploaded docs and candidate consent to ticket. I'll submit EOR request.

people-ops-bot: Checklist: do not complete I-9 until candidate is physically in US with valid work authorization. Use secure payroll upload for sensitive docs.

anya-legal: Note for record: document decision and candidate consent in hiring ticket; include conversion plan to Redwood W-2 upon US arrival.

marta-peopleops: Great, proceeding with EOR request. Keeping thread short; updates as vendor confirms.
